story: Turkish intelligence said the Kurdistan Workers' Party withdrew from 14 more bases in northern Iraq as part of an ongoing peace process with Turkey.
The United Kingdom formally recognised the Rohingya genocide and sanctioned five senior Myanmar military leaders following an International Court of Justice ruling.
California Representative Jimmy Gomez said he will resign from Congress on 1 December after the House Ethics Committee found substantial evidence of sexual misconduct with a staffer.
CrowdStrike agreed to buy cloud security firm Zscaler in an all-stock deal worth about $44 billion.
University of Copenhagen researchers mapped the complete biosynthetic pathway of the cancer drug paclitaxel and produced it in tobacco plants at levels comparable to yew tree bark.
